dataset_versions.injection_corpus: self-generated, scripts/make_injection_corpus.py (see its manifest for its own git_commit)

source_licence: see data/LICENCES.md -- no EULA; images NOT redistributable, so this corpus is regenerated, never committed

pair_selection.criterion: highest ArcFace cosine between identity mean embeddings, greedily matched within a split, each identity used at most once
pair_selection.rationale: a morph is only a threat if it plausibly passes for both contributors; embedding similarity is what an attacker optimises when choosing an accomplice, is measurable, and needs no demographic labels this corpus does not have

splits.policy: identities partitioned before pairing; pairs and bona fide drawn only within a partition; asserted subject-disjoint at generation time
